channel.title: Laravel Tips - Punyapal Shah
channel.description: Curated developer tips, architectural patterns, and testing techniques for Laravel, PHP, and modern web development.

item.title: Use Laravel's remember_token as a Revocation Signal
item.description: Use Laravel's remembertoken as an invalidation signal for saved account-switching state without maintaining a dedicated token or revocation table.

item.title: Git Submodule vs. Git Subtree: Which Should You Use?
item.description: A practical comparison of Git Submodules and Git Subtrees to help you choose the right strategy for embedding one repository inside another.

item.title: Cache Playwright and Puppeteer Browsers in GitHub Actions
item.description: Cache browser binaries with actions/cache to avoid downloading 150MB+ on every CI run.

item.title: Skip Expensive CI Steps Using git diff Instead of File Timestamps
item.description: File modification timestamps are unreliable in GitHub Actions. Use git diff to detect actual changes and conditionally skip expensive workflow steps.

item.title: Write Files Incrementally in Build Scripts to Avoid Unnecessary Rebuilds
item.description: Compare generated content against existing files before writing. This prevents unnecessary git diffs, cache invalidation, and downstream rebuilds.

item.title: Mask Query Bindings in Laravel Exception Messages
item.description: Keep query bindings out of QueryException messages while retaining access to the actual bindings.

item.title: Ignore Local Files Without Modifying .gitignore Using .git/info/exclude
item.description: Use .git/info/exclude to ignore personal scratch files, local debug scripts, and notes without polluting your team's shared .gitignore file.

item.title: Stream CSV Downloads in Laravel Without Creating Temporary Files
item.description: Combine response()->streamDownload(), php://output, and query chunking to stream CSV exports directly to the browser without writing temporary files to disk.

item.title: Define Custom Macros on the Eloquent Builder
item.description: Register reusable query methods directly on the Builder so every model gains access without repeating logic.

item.title: Prevent Navigation Layout Shifts and Flickering in Web Applications
item.description: Fix common navigation bar layout shifts, scrollbar jumps, font width shifts, and theme switcher flickering with clean CSS and HTML patterns.

item.title: Reusable Migration Fields with Custom Blueprint Macros
item.description: Extend Laravel's Blueprint class with custom macros to standardize and reuse common schema columns across database migrations.

item.title: Trigger a GitHub Actions Workflow Across Repositories
item.description: Use repositorydispatch to trigger a workflow in a target repository when commits or PRs land in a source repository.

item.title: Never Return Statements inside Finally Blocks in PHP
item.description: Placing a return statement inside a try-catch finally block silently overrides exceptions and previous return statements.

item.title: Automate PHP Readonly Class Refactoring with Rector
item.description: Use Rector rules to automatically convert immutable DTOs and value objects into native PHP 8.2 readonly classes.

item.title: Use sole() Instead of firstOrFail() for Single Record Guarantees
item.description: When you expect exactly one matching record, use sole() instead of firstOrFail(). It guards against multiple records by throwing MultipleRecordsFoundException.

item.title: Protect Custom Artisan Commands from AI Agents with Prohibitable
item.description: Use Laravel's Prohibitable trait on custom Artisan commands to selectively block AI agents from running destructive domain operations.

item.title: Detect AI Agents in Laravel with AgentDetector and PAO
item.description: Laravel's AgentDetector detects whether an AI coding agent is interacting with your app, and PAO optimizes CLI output for agents.

item.title: Stream Large Datasets: cursor() vs lazy() in Eloquent
item.description: cursor() hydrates single model instances sequentially using database cursors; lazy() streams records in chunks backed by LazyCollection.

item.title: Choose the Right Processing Method: chunk(), lazy(), chunkById(), lazyById()
item.description: Understand offset vs keyset pagination when processing large datasets to avoid missing records during updates.

item.title: UI Controls Are Not Security Layers: Always Enforce Policies
item.description: Hiding buttons in Blade or Vue does not restrict access. Always enforce authorization policies in controller or request layers.

item.title: Dispatch Jobs After Transaction Commit with DB::afterCommit()
item.description: Use DB::afterCommit() to defer job dispatching until surrounding database transactions complete successfully.

item.title: Assert JSON Columns and Backed Enums with assertDatabaseHas
item.description: In Laravel and Pest tests, assertDatabaseHas() natively queries nested JSON properties using arrow syntax and accepts backed Enum instances directly.

item.title: Streamline Testing with Pest Test Impact Analysis (TIA)
item.description: Enable the Tia Engine in Pest to only re-run tests affected by your latest code changes while replaying cached results for unaffected tests.

item.title: Protect Production with Laravel Prohibitable Commands
item.description: Prevent catastrophic accidents like db:wipe or migrate:fresh in production using Laravel's Prohibitable trait and DB::prohibitDestructiveCommands().

item.title: Why strip_tags() Is Not Enough for XSS Protection
item.description: striptags() removes HTML elements but fails to sanitize inline attributes or malformed HTML payload vectors. Use HTMLPurifier for rich text input.

item.title: Clean Up Complex Multi-Step Operations with Illuminate Pipeline
item.description: Process complex data sequences or multi-stage order checks through Laravel's built-in Pipeline facade to replace massive controller methods.

item.title: Clean Up Redundant Code Comments with a Custom Rector Rule
item.description: Use a custom Rector rule to automatically strip noisy inline comments and empty docblocks across your codebase while preserving essential PHPDoc annotations.

item.title: Automatically Discard Orphaned Queue Jobs with deleteWhenMissingModels
item.description: Use the $deleteWhenMissingModels property on queued jobs to silently discard jobs if their referenced database records were deleted before execution.

item.title: Prevent Queue Payload Bloat with withoutRelations()
item.description: Use withoutRelations() when passing models to queue jobs to prevent large in-memory relationship graphs from serializing into queue storage.

item.title: Optimize Queue Worker Polling Overheads in Production
item.description: Use queue:work with appropriate sleep configuration or Redis blocking pops to reduce database CPU polling overheads.

item.title: Auto-Scale Queue Workers with --stop-when-empty-for in Laravel
item.description: The --stop-when-empty-for option keeps queue workers alive for a specific grace period after the queue empties, preventing rapid process churn during bursty workloads.

item.title: Optimize Date Queries by Replacing whereYear() with whereBetween()
item.description: Replace whereYear() and whereMonth() on large database tables with whereBetween() date ranges to enable SQL index lookups.

item.title: Prevent Duplicate Redis and Database Lookups with Cache::memo()
item.description: Use Cache::memo() to combine persistent cache stores with per-request memory caching, preventing repetitive network roundtrips during a single HTTP request.

item.title: Index Dynamic JSON Attributes with Generated Virtual Columns
item.description: Use virtualAs() and storedAs() in migrations to create generated database columns for high-speed indexing on JSON attributes.

item.title: Tick-Based Execution Timeout Wrapper in PHP Without PCNTL
item.description: Interrupt long-running synchronous PHP callables on any operating system using PHP tick declarations and tick callback functions without requiring the pcntl extension.

item.title: Detect Cumulative Database Query Spikes with whenQueryingForLongerThan()
item.description: Use DB::whenQueryingForLongerThan() to monitor the cumulative time spent in database queries per HTTP request and notify developers of slow requests.

item.title: Reusable Tappable Scopes for Eloquent and Laravel Scout Queries
item.description: Extract query filtering logic into invokable scope classes that work interchangeably across Eloquent query builders and Laravel Scout search instances.

item.title: Ditch sleep() in Tests: Use Laravel Time Travel Helpers
item.description: Use $this->travelTo() or freezeTime() in test suites to test date-sensitive logic without slowing down test execution with sleep().

item.title: Integer Enums: Start Indexing from 1, Avoid 0
item.description: When creating integer-backed PHP Enums, index starting from 1 to avoid false-y evaluation bugs in loose comparisons.

item.title: Complete Guide to PHPStan Static Analysis Levels (0 to 10)
item.description: Understand what each rule level in PHPStan inspects, from basic syntax errors at Level 0 to strict mixed-type enforcement at Level 9 and Level 10.

item.title: Generic Classes and Functions in PHP Using PHPDoc @template
item.description: Implement type-safe generic collections, wrapper classes, and utility functions in PHP using PHPDoc template annotations for static analysis engines.

item.title: Typed Arrays and Array Shapes in PHP with PHPDoc
item.description: Document and enforce structured array schemas using PHPDoc array shapes, lists, and non-empty array annotations for static analysis in PHPStan and Psalm.

item.title: Prevent Information Disclosure with Gate::denyAsNotFound()
item.description: Use Response::denyAsNotFound() in policies to return a 404 Not Found response instead of 403 Forbidden, concealing the existence of private resources.

item.title: Execute Multi-Step Business Workflows with the Pipeline Facade
item.description: Use Laravel's Pipeline facade to pass objects through sequential pipe classes, keeping complex order processing and data transformations modular.

item.title: Detect and Eliminate N+1 Queries in Development with preventLazyLoading()
item.description: Enable Model::preventLazyLoading() in local development to automatically throw exceptions whenever a relationship is lazy loaded.

item.title: Refactor PHP Enum Cases from snake_case to PascalCase with Rector
item.description: Automate renaming PHP 8.1+ enum cases from SNAKECASE to PascalCase across PHP classes and Blade templates using Rector and an Artisan refactoring script.

item.title: Automate Laravel 11 casts() Method Upgrade with Rector
item.description: Use Rector to automatically refactor legacy protected $casts array properties into the modern casts() method across your entire Laravel codebase.

item.title: Cast Enums Inside JSON and Array Column Keys in Eloquent
item.description: Cast enum instances nested within JSON or array database columns using Eloquent Attribute accessors and mutators.

item.title: Combine Custom Casts and Enums for Complex Attributes
item.description: Use Eloquent custom casts (CastsAttributes) to handle complex JSON serialization and Backed Enum arrays cleanly.

item.title: Fix Blade View Cache Compilation for Teleport Directives in Livewire
item.description: Prevent view compilation glitches when running php artisan view:cache on templates using @teleport by registering explicit Blade directives.

item.title: Centralized Application Activity Logging with Laravel Event Subscribers
item.description: Capture HTTP requests, Artisan CLI commands, and outgoing API responses into a unified audit trail using a single Laravel Event Subscriber.

item.title: Efficient Unique Slug Generation in Eloquent Without Looping Queries
item.description: Generate unique database slugs in Eloquent by querying the maximum existing numerical suffix directly instead of executing repeated queries in a while loop.

item.title: Freeze and Inspect Application Time in Tests with Carbon setTestNow()
item.description: Control system time during testing and development using Carbon::setTestNow() and inspect active time mocks with Carbon::hasTestNow().

item.title: Stream CSV Report Downloads with Renderless Livewire Component Actions
item.description: Use Livewire 3's #Renderless attribute to stream file downloads directly from component actions without triggering unnecessary view re-renders or database queries.

item.title: Multi-Tenant Team Scoping with a Reusable BelongsToTeam Model Trait
item.description: Automatically assign tenant IDs and restrict Eloquent queries using a reusable BelongsToTeam model trait with model booting and global scopes.

item.title: Reusable whereLike Macro with Relationship and Expression Support
item.description: Simplify multi-column wildcard searches across model columns, relationships, and raw SQL expressions using a powerful whereLike macro on the Eloquent Builder.

item.title: Speed Up Test Suites with the LazilyRefreshDatabase Trait
item.description: Use LazilyRefreshDatabase instead of RefreshDatabase to run database transactions only for tests that actually touch the database.

item.title: Reuse Model Instances Across Nested Factories with Factory recycle()
item.description: Use Factory::recycle() to pass existing parent models to child factories, avoiding duplicate database record creation in test fixtures.

item.title: Work Around MySQL Subquery Restrictions on Target Tables
item.description: MySQL prevents updating a table while selecting from it in a subquery. Wrap subqueries in an intermediate alias table.

item.title: Build Conditional Transformation Pipelines with Collection::when() and whenEmpty()
item.description: Use when(), unless(), and whenEmpty() on Laravel Collections to conditionally apply transformations without breaking method chains.

item.title: Catch Unmocked External API Calls with Http::preventStrayRequests()
item.description: Enable Http::preventStrayRequests() in test suites to throw exceptions whenever HTTP requests are made without explicit mocks.

item.title: Query Relationships Across Multiple Database Connections
item.description: Query related models located on different database connections using whereHas() without cross-database join errors.

item.title: Query JSON and Array ID Columns with Array-Column Relationships
item.description: Define relationships on models where foreign keys are stored as JSON arrays or comma-separated lists rather than traditional single-id foreign keys.

item.title: Test Time Delays Without Slowing Down Tests Using the Sleep Helper
item.description: Replace PHP's native sleep() and usleep() with Laravel's Sleep facade to write testable, fakeable time pauses.

item.title: Use CSS Container Queries for Modular Component Layouts
item.description: Use CSS Container Queries (@container) to adjust component layouts based on parent container width rather than viewport size.

item.title: Log and Audit Slow Database Queries with DB::listen()
item.description: Use DB::listen() in AppServiceProvider to monitor executed queries, log slow operations, and inspect raw SQL bindings during local development.
